blocks.label: Practice
blocks.instructions:
Contact Classification — PracticeContacts appear on the bearing display.
  • Mechanical contact: click the LEFT half of the screen
  • Biological contact: click the RIGHT half of the screen
  • Respond based on contact type — ignore where it appears on the display
  • Most contacts appear on the expected side; occasional contacts appear on the opposite side
  • Respond as quickly and accurately as possible

blocks.label: Main Task
blocks.instructions:
Contact ClassificationMechanical → LEFT. Biological → RIGHT.
  • Respond based on contact type regardless of where it appears.
  • No feedback in this block.
